comments.note: No blocking issues. CPM migration is textbook — 26 unique packages correctly centralized, all csproj files cleanly stripped of Version attributes, VideoIndexer.Core.csproj (zero PackageReferences) correctly excluded. The two PropertyGroup split in Directory.Build.props is an intentional, defensible visual distinction — not a defect.

Directory.Packages.props structure is excellent: six vendor-scoped ItemGroups with ASCII-art header comments, and a meaningful inline note on the SharpCompress 0.x versioning caveat. Future maintainers will find dependency management straightforward.

[documentation-forward] Directory.Packages.props: a brief file-level XML comment (above the first ItemGroup) explaining that this file is the canonical version authority for all NuGet packages in the solution, and that new packages must be registered here before referencing them in any .csproj, would help onboard contributors unfamiliar with CPM.
